descriptionHtml:
MSI G255F 24.5 FHD 180Hz Rapid IPS Gaming Monitor (24.5 Inch Full HD 1920x1080 / 180Hz Refresh Rate / Rapid IPS Panel / 1ms GTG Response Time / 99% sRGB Wide Color Gamut / Adaptive-Sync Technology / Night Vision Smart Tuner / Frameless Design / DisplayPort 1.2a & Dual HDMI 2.0b / 1 Year Warranty)

Gain the competitive edge in esports with the MSI G255F 24.5-inch FHD gaming monitor, available at Turbo Computer Egypt with a 1-Year Warranty. Equipped with an ultra-fast Rapid IPS panel, it delivers a smooth 180Hz refresh rate and a rapid 1ms GTG response time to eliminate screen blurring and motion ghosting. Featuring Adaptive-Sync technology for tear-free gameplay, Night Vision smart tuner for enhancing shadow details, and 99% sRGB color accuracy, this monitor combines rich visuals with eye-care protections like Anti-Flicker and Less Blue Light for long gaming sessions.
